steps.label: 2259-own-shared-html-editor-tab-open
command: (() => {if(location.pathname!=='/item/all/modify.donga'||new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('itemId')!=='2089242'||document.querySelector('.modal.show'))throw Error('Own modify required');const tabs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tab]')].filter(e=>e.getAttribute('href')==='#tabItem');if(tabs.length!==1)throw Error('Observed HTML tab required');tabs[0].click();return {text:tabs[0].innerText,target:tabs[0].getAttribute('href')};})()
